commit.message:
fix(ui): GPU tests fall back to the hardware adapter and say when they skip

macOS's Metal has no software adapter, so the forced-fallback request
failed on every Mac: gpu_render / trace_composite / trace_parity passed
without rendering and the headless run (headless_run_succeeds, the two
headless CLI tests) failed with "No suitable graphics adapter found".

New camcraft_ui::headless_gpu: software adapter first (lavapipe/WARP on
Linux/Windows, unchanged), then the platform's hardware adapter, and it
reports which. The headless shell run and all three GPU suites use it.
With no adapter at all a GPU test prints a loud SKIPPED line;
CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU=1 makes that a failure. No tolerance changed.

Fixes #615
